award_lead: The Critic's citations, awarded with visible reluctance:

burst_mode.evidence: {burst_record} screenshots inside a single minute. Frenetic editing, no establishing shots. The Critic reached for the pause button and found none.
burst_mode.name: Rapid Montage

night_owl.evidence: {night_count} screenshots between 10 PM and 5 AM, {night_share:.1f}% of the program. The Critic has seen this film before; it is shot entirely at night, and the lighting never improves.
night_owl.name: Nocturne in a Minor Key

screenshot_streak.evidence: {longest_streak} consecutive days in release. A long run by any measure, though the material remains, stubbornly, the same.
screenshot_streak.name: The Long Run

intro: The Critic presides, notebook open, expectations managed. {count} screenshots are about to be reviewed, and the review will not be kind merely for the sake of it.
name: The Critic

sentences.Felony-Level Archivist: Sentence: the deluxe edition of a habit. Delete nothing; the director's commentary would suffer.
sentences.Habitual Hoarder: Sentence: an endurance piece. Organization is ordered, then suspended, in the manner of all sequels.
sentences.Innocent Bystander: Sentence: dismissed without a review. There was, charitably, nothing here to review.
sentences.Petty Offender: Sentence: a minor work in a minor key. One duplicate deleted, as a gesture toward a plot.
sentences.Repeat Offender: Sentence: a franchise nobody greenlit. The court orders a monthly check-in and considerably lower ambitions.
sentences.Unrepentant Screenshot Felon: Sentence: a maximalist epic, assembled without a single cut. The court declines to trim a frame and quietly questions its own judgment.
